description: This file provides utility functions for parsing command-line arguments and environment variables, including functions to consume flags of various types (string, integer, float, boolean) and handle command-line argument arrays. It is part of a script library for argument processing.

methods.name: readEnvNumber
methods.description: Reads and parses a numerical value from environment variables, returning null if not present or invalid.

methods.name: consumeStringFlag
methods.description: Checks if a command-line argument matches a specified flag and retrieves the associated string value.

methods.name: consumeStringListFlag
methods.description: Checks for a flag and returns the following argument as a string list element.

methods.name: consumeIntFlag
methods.description: Checks for a flag and parses the following argument as an integer, respecting minimum constraints.

methods.name: consumeFloatFlag
methods.description: Checks for a flag and parses the following argument as a float, respecting minimum constraints.

methods.name: stringFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag parser for string flags.

methods.name: stringListFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag parser for string list flags.

methods.name: intFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag parser for integer flags.

methods.name: floatFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag parser for float flags.

methods.name: booleanFlag
methods.description: Creates a boolean flag parser that sets a target key to true or specified value.

methods.name: parseFlagArgs
methods.description: Main function to parse command-line arguments based on provided specifications.
